name: dropdown-menu-switchers
title: Workspace and model switchers
description: Workspace and model switchers. Core/Overlays & Menus/DropdownMenu pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/DropdownMenu and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system. Demo assets referenced (supply your own or copy them into public/): /avatars/person-41.svg, static/images/art/2.svg, static/images/art/6.svg.
